title: The $L^q$-bounds for Derivatives of Unitary Developments of Random Continuous Geometric Rough Paths
summary: In this paper we derive an explicit formula for derivatives of unitary developments of random continuous geometric rough paths of all orders and establish proper $L^q$-bounds for them, which allow us to study the analyticity of their characteristic functions in a quantitative manner and then prove that under some mild conditions the distributions of the signatures of random continuous geometric rough paths are determined by their expected signatures, provided the latter have positive radius of convergence.
